root: ^Drogo: A fierce battle... but the stone has awakened. Yes... Molok has heard us.
^Cacildes: What are you talking about? Stop this, Drogo! I don’t want to fight you again—but I will if I must.
^Drogo: You fought well. For a human, you’ve earned my respect. But you rely too much on your strength… and it’s only slightly above ordinary.
^Drogo: Now... Molok... feel the fire of your kin. Awaken, and be free of your chains at last...
^Cacildes: Drogo—what are you doing? Stop! Now!
